# Vatayan Labs

> Independent, data-driven research on Indian banking, payments, mutual funds and capital markets, by Manu Vatayan Jha. Every number is sourced from primary regulatory data (RBI, NPCI, SEBI, AMFI) and company filings. "Vatayan" is Sanskrit for window — a window into how India moves money.

## Live dashboards (interactive, primary data)

- [RBI Annual Report 2025-26 Dashboard](https://vatayanlabs.com/dashboards/rbi-annual-report-2025-26/): India credit growth, payments, money supply and financial inclusion from the RBI Annual Report.
- [India Payments Intelligence](https://vatayanlabs.com/dashboards/india-payments/): UPI QR, credit card, debit card and ATM trends from RBI monthly returns, March 2024 to June 2026 — including the digital-vs-cash crossover and the four consecutive months digital has held the majority.
- [Bank vs Bank — Payments Comparison](https://vatayanlabs.com/dashboards/india-payments/compare/): Head-to-head comparison of any two Indian banks across 25 RBI payment metrics, plus peer-group league tables for PSUs, private banks, small finance banks, payments banks and foreign banks.
- [India Banking Scorecard](https://vatayanlabs.com/dashboards/indian-banks/): Quarterly reported PAT, Gross NPA and Net NPA for 25 Indian banks and NBFCs, Q2FY25-Q1FY27, plus market cap, P/E, P/BV, RoE and RoA snapshots.

## Sector studies (long-form research)

- [Gold](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/gold/): India's Rs 16.8 lakh crore gold loan story — 3-part series.
- [Defence](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/defence/): "Read the Defence" — 7-part series on India's defence decade, HAL, BEL and the value chain.
- [Microfinance](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/microfinance/): The microfinance stress cycle and the CGSMFI-2.0 credit guarantee.
- [Mutual Funds](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/mutual-funds/): The SIP illusion, momentum funds, the 77% concentration problem in Indian equity portfolios, and India's first REIT index fund.
- [Semiconductors](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/semiconductors/): Company business studies from the US semiconductor and optical supply chain.
- [Lumentum — Business Study](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/semiconductors/lumentum/): Five-part study of Lumentum ($LITE) — photonics, the NVIDIA relationship, valuation and the India angle.
- [Capital Markets](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/capital-markets/): 4-part series on India's market infrastructure — depositories (CDSL/NSDL), RTAs and global peers.

## Tools (interactive calculators)

- [Tools shelf](https://vatayanlabs.com/tools/): Calculators for Indian personal finance, built so that every assumption is a visible input and every cost is counted on both sides of a comparison.
- [Buy a flat, or rent and invest the difference?](https://vatayanlabs.com/tools/buy-vs-invest/): Rent-vs-buy calculator for Indian residential property. Holds both choices to an identical monthly cash budget; models stamp duty and registration, home-loan relief under Sec 24(b) and 80C by tax regime, rental income taxed with the 30% standard deduction and the house-property loss set-off cap, capital gains on both the flat and the fund, fund expense ratio, vacancy, maintenance and periodic repairs, prepayment and EMI step-up. Includes a two-way return sensitivity grid and a Monte Carlo run reporting how often each choice wins. Scenarios are shareable by URL and exportable to CSV.
- [Retirement & Life Goals Calculator](https://vatayanlabs.com/tools/retirement/): Goal-based retirement planning for India. Each life goal (house, car, child schooling/graduation/post-graduation/marriage, travel) is entered in today's money with a target year and inflated at a category-specific rate — education at 10%, marriage 7%, vehicles 5%. When the pot is short, per-goal rules decide what gives: must-fund, defer (re-priced at the later year), or scale down to a floor; priority settles goals competing in the same year. EPF (with the EPS diversion and wage ceiling) and NPS tier-I (with an equity glide path and the mandatory 40% annuitisation) are held in a locked pot separate from the SIP pot that funds goals. Solves in both directions: required monthly SIP for a stated corpus, or the corpus derived from stated retirement spending. Draws the corpus down to a stated life expectancy to report whether the money lasts.
